title: Case 07: Platform Zero
subtitle: A commuter disappears from a moving subway train between stations. CCTV shows him board, but nobody sees him leave.
loop_reset_text: Tunnel lights reverse one by one. The carriage jolts backward to 6:24 AM.

carriage.name: Subway Carriage
carriage.description: A sealed train car, folding seats and floor bolts polished by years of commuters.

platform.name: Platform 12
platform.description: Morning crowds hide small movements. A photographer caught more than he realized.

tunnel.name: Maintenance Tunnel
tunnel.description: An old service hatch runs beneath the carriage line during the signal slowdown.

control.name: Transit Control
control.description: Signal logs and surveillance routing reveal a deliberate three-minute blind spot.

samira.name: Samira Khan
dialogue: I warned the victim about a security leak.
He had a reason to fear someone on the train.

contradiction.result: Samira's radio call and maintenance map prove she warned the victim and helped him plan an escape route.

ethan.name: Ethan Cole
dialogue: I was just going to work.
That tunnel dust could belong to anyone.

contradiction.result: Kenji's reflection photo, shoeprint and carriage weight change prove Ethan followed the victim through the hatch.

tariq.name: Tariq Malik
dialogue: I slowed the train for signal maintenance.
I did not know anyone would use it.

contradiction.result: Tariq created the slowdown and unlocked the hatch, but his control-room log keeps him away from the tunnel.

julia.name: Julia Mason
dialogue: He never told me he was in danger.
He said he had evidence against a contractor.
I begged him not to take the train.

contradiction.result: Julia knew about the danger but her messages show she tried to stop him, not trap him.

kenji.name: Kenji Ito
dialogue: I did not notice the reflection until you showed me.
That man was watching the victim before boarding.

contradiction.result: Kenji's image reveals Ethan tracking the victim before the train even departed.

bolts.name: Scratched Floor Bolts
bolts.description: Fresh tool marks surround the folding seat above the hidden hatch.

map.name: Old Maintenance Map
map.description: A discontinued service hatch aligns exactly under the carriage slowdown point.

sensor.name: Carriage Weight Shift
sensor.description: Two adult-weight drops occur while the train is still moving.

photo.name: Platform Reflection Photo
photo.description: A window reflection shows Ethan watching the victim before boarding.

radio.name: Emergency Radio Call
radio.description: Samira warns the victim to use the hatch if the train slows unexpectedly.

shoeprint.name: Tunnel Shoeprint
shoeprint.description: A fresh tread matches Ethan's shoes and follows the victim's path.

signal.name: Signal Slowdown Log
signal.description: Tariq scheduled an unscheduled three-minute crawl through the old service section.

message.name: Julia's Warning Message
message.description: Julia begged the victim to skip the train after he mentioned being followed.

deduction_prompt: Who followed the victim through the hidden maintenance hatch after his planned escape?
truth: The disappearance was voluntary at first. Samira warned the victim, Tariq's slowdown created the opportunity, and the victim escaped through the old hatch. Ethan, working for the company under investigation, followed him into the tunnel and killed him.
partial: You identify Ethan but fail to prove the victim escaped voluntarily before being attacked.
wrong: Your theory cannot explain the weight shift, the hidden hatch and Ethan's tunnel footprint. The train rolls backward.
